study_identification_part.si_4_title: Microstructural mapping of neural pathways in Alzheimer's disease using macrostructure-informed normative tractometry

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Macrostructure-informed normative tractometry (MINT) uses a variational autoencoder (VAE) with 1D convolutional layers (ConvVAE) to model tract geometry and microstructure.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: This study proposes macrostructure-informed normative tractometry (MINT) † to jointly model microstructural measures and cooccurring variations in bundle geometry with a variational autoencoder (VAE).; We previously showed that using this approach, a VAE with 1D convolutional layers (ConvVAE) preserves streamline and bundle distances in the latent space by training on only 3D coordinates.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Normative modeling uses four DTI microstructural measures (FA, MD, RD, AxD) projected along tractography streamlines; macrostructure (streamline geometry) is modeled jointly.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: After processing dMRI, diffusion tensors were fitted at each voxel using the non-linear least-squares method to produce FA, MD, RD, and AxD scalar maps in the dMRI native space.; As shown in Figure 2C, MINT is trained on whole-brain macrostructure as well as the four standard DTI microstructural measures.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: 2.2.2 National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences; Feng2025.pdf.md: 2.3.1 Macrostructure modeling

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The VAE-based normative model is unsupervised and learns from streamline coordinates and microstructural features; no explicit explanatory covariates (e.g., age, sex) are specified for the VAE model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: In our macrostructure-informed normative tractometry (MINT) framework, a key component is the VAE model, which learns patterns of macrostructural (tract shape and geometry) variation in a healthy population based on the 3D streamline coordinates provided by tractography in addition to the microstructural features along those coordinates.
